recipes.name: Carne Asada
recipes.description: Citrus-chile marinated grilled beef for tacos.

steps.instruction: Marinate 2h; pat dry.
Grill ripping hot 3 min/side; rest.
Chop fine; pile into tortillas with cilantro-onion-salsa.

videos.videoTitle: How Mexico Makes the Perfect Carne Asada Tacos

recipes.name: Beef Birria
recipes.description: Jalisco chile-braised shredded beef with consommé for dipping.

steps.instruction: Blend soaked chiles; sear beef.
Braise in sauce+water 3h till shredding.
Dip tortillas in fat-cap consommé; griddle with meat+cheese.

videos.videoTitle: The Ultimate BIRRIA de Res Recipe Guide: Tacos, Consome, Quesabirria & Ramen | Arnie's Cafe & Grill

recipes.name: Caldo de Res
recipes.description: Big-bone beef-vegetable soup, Mexican Sunday reset.

ingredients.name: Corn on Cob, Potato, Chayote, Carrot, Cabbage

steps.instruction: Simmer beef 90 min skimming.
Add veg by hardness; cook tender.
Cilantro finish; lime + salsa at table.

recipes.name: Machaca con Huevo
recipes.description: Shredded dried-beef scramble - northern breakfast legend.

steps.instruction: Sofrito veggies hot pan.
Toast machaca 2 min; eggs in; soft-scramble.

recipes.name: Chicken Tinga Tostadas
recipes.description: Chipotle-tomato shredded chicken piled crisp tostadas.

steps.instruction: Poach chicken; shred.
Cook onion-tomato-chipotle sauce 10 min; fold chicken.
Simmer 10; build tostadas with crema + queso.

recipes.name: Enchiladas Suizas
recipes.description: Tomatillo-cream chicken enchiladas baked under melted cheese.

steps.instruction: Roast-blend tomatillos; stir cream.
Fill-roll chicken tortillas into sauced dish.
More sauce + cheese; bake 200°C 15 min.

videos.videoTitle: Rick Bayless Enchiladas Suizas (Creamy Chicken Enchiladas with Melted Cheese)

recipes.name: Pollo Asado
recipes.description: Achiote-citrus marinated grilled chicken quarters.

steps.instruction: Marinate overnight.
Grill indirect then char skin.
Rest; onions + lime alongside.

videos.videoTitle: Two Recipes for POLLO ASADO: Traditional Mexican Grilled Chicken & Texas Style Sweet Heat BBQ Sauce

recipes.name: Chilaquiles con Pollo
recipes.description: Tortilla chips simmered in salsa, topped with chicken and egg.

steps.instruction: Heat salsa; toss chips briefly half-softened.
Plate fast; chicken over.
Egg + crema + queso + onion rings.

videos.videoTitle: How to Make Cast Iron Chicken Chilaquiles | Julia At Home (S3 E6)

recipes.name: Tacos de Rajas con Crema
recipes.description: Roasted poblano strips in cream with corn - vegetarian taco king.

steps.instruction: Char-peel poblanos; slice rajas.
Saute onion+corn; fold rajas + crema.
Fill tortillas; queso crumble.

videos.videoTitle: Como Hacer Tacos de Rajas con Queso

recipes.name: Esquites
recipes.description: Warm corn-in-a-cup with mayo-lime-chile-cheese.

steps.instruction: Simmer corn with epazote if handy.
Drain slightly; fold mayo-crema.
Cup it: cotija, chile, lime squeeze.

recipes.name: Ensalada de Nopales
recipes.description: Clean-tasting cactus paddles with tomato, onion, queso.

steps.instruction: Boil nopales 10 min till tender-dry; rinse cold.
Fold with veg, oil, lime, salt.
Chill; cheese optional on top.

recipes.name: Quesadillas de Flor de Calabaza
recipes.description: Squash-blossom and Oaxaca cheese quesadillas.

steps.instruction: Wilt onion+blossoms quickly.
Cheese + filling on tortillas; fold.
Comal-griddle both sides till molten.

recipes.name: Flan Napolitano
recipes.description: Cream-cheese enriched caramel flan, impossibly silky.

steps.instruction: Amber caramel into mold; coat sides.
Blend smooth custard; strain in.
Water bath 170°C ~60 min; chill; invert.

recipes.name: Pastel de Tres Leches
recipes.description: Sponge soaked in three milks, whipped cream capped.

steps.instruction: Bake sponge; cool 15; poke all over.
Pour milk mix slowly till absorbed; chill 4h.
Whipped cream cap; cinnamon lines.

recipes.name: Barbacoa
recipes.description: Slow-cooked shredded beef wrapped in maguey leaves, a classic Mexican weekend dish served with consommé.

steps.instruction: Toast guajillo chiles in a dry pan until fragrant, then soak in hot water for 20 minutes.
Blend soaked chiles with onion, garlic, cumin, oregano, pepper, and salt into a smooth adobo.
Score beef cheeks and rub the adobo all over, marinating for at least 2 hours.
Line a pot with maguey leaves, place beef inside, add bay leaves, and pour in water.
Cover tightly and cook in a 150°C oven for 4-5 hours until fork-tender.
Shred the beef and serve with the strained cooking consommé on the side.

recipes.name: Suadero
recipes.description: Tender beef brisket cooked slowly in its own fat until crispy on the outside and succulent within.

steps.instruction: Score the brisket in a crosshatch pattern and season with salt, pepper, and oregano.
Heat lard in a heavy skillet over medium-low heat and add the onion halves.
Place the brisket in the pan and cook slowly for 1.5 hours, turning occasionally.
Increase heat slightly in the last 15 minutes to crisp the exterior.
Rest the meat for 10 minutes, then slice thinly against the grain.
Serve in warm corn tortillas with salsa verde and fresh cilantro.

recipes.name: Carne Molida con Papas
recipes.description: Mexican-style ground beef and potatoes in a savory tomato-based sauce, a weeknight family staple.

steps.instruction: Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and brown the ground beef, breaking it apart.
Add onion, garlic, and jalapeño, cooking until softened.
Pour in the blended tomatoes, cumin, oregano, and salt.
Add diced potatoes and stir to combine.
Cover and simmer for 20-25 minutes until potatoes are tender and sauce has thickened.
Adjust seasoning and serve with warm flour tortillas or over rice.

recipes.name: Picadillo
recipes.description: A savory ground beef hash with olives, raisins, and potatoes, blending sweet and savory flavors.

steps.instruction: Heat oil in a large skillet and brown the ground beef, breaking it into small pieces.
Add onion and garlic, cooking until fragrant.
Stir in tomatoes, cumin, oregano, and salt.
Add diced potatoes and cook covered for 15 minutes.
Fold in olives and raisins, cooking for another 5 minutes.
Serve with warm corn tortillas and refried beans.

recipes.name: Discada
recipes.description: A rustic Northern Mexican stir-fry of mixed meats cooked on a plow disc over an open flame.

steps.instruction: Heat a large disc or cast-iron skillet over high heat.
Cook bacon until crispy, then push to the side of the disc.
Add beef and pork, searing until browned on all sides.
Add chorizo and cook until it renders its fat.
Toss in onion, garlic, tomatoes, and jalapeños.
Stir everything together and cook for 5 more minutes until the vegetables are softened.
Serve immediately with warm corn tortillas and lime wedges.

recipes.name: Machaca
recipes.description: Shredded dried beef rehydrated and sautéed with eggs, tomatoes, and chiles for a hearty breakfast.

steps.instruction: Soak dried beef in warm water for 30 minutes, then shred finely.
Heat oil in a skillet and sauté onion, garlic, and jalapeño until soft.
Add shredded beef and cook for 5 minutes until slightly crispy.
Stir in diced tomatoes and cook for 3 more minutes.
Beat eggs and pour over the mixture, scrambling everything together.
Season with salt and serve with warm flour tortillas and refried beans.

recipes.name: Bistec Encebollado
recipes.description: Thin beef steaks smothered in caramelized onions, a beloved Mexican home-style comfort dish.

steps.instruction: Season steaks with lime juice, salt, pepper, and cumin. Let rest for 15 minutes.
Heat oil in a large skillet over high heat.
Sear steaks for 2-3 minutes per side, then remove and set aside.
In the same pan, add onion rings and cook on medium heat for 15 minutes until caramelized.
Return steaks to the pan and nestle into the onions.
Cover and cook for 5 more minutes. Serve with rice and beans.

recipes.name: Carne Guisada
recipes.description: Tender beef chunks slow-simmered in a rich cumin-spiced gravy until fork-tender.

steps.instruction: Toss beef cubes with flour, salt, and cumin.
Heat oil in a Dutch oven and brown beef in batches, setting aside.
Sauté onion, garlic, and jalapeño until fragrant.
Return beef, add tomatoes, oregano, and broth.
Bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 1.5 hours.
Adjust seasoning and serve with warm flour tortillas.

recipes.name: Fajitas de Res
recipes.description: Sizzling marinated beef strips with bell peppers and onions, served with warm tortillas.

steps.instruction: Marinate beef strips with lime juice, olive oil, garlic, cumin, chili powder, paprika, and salt for at least 30 minutes.
Heat a cast-iron skillet over high heat until smoking.
Sear beef strips in a single layer for 2 minutes per side, then remove.
In the same skillet, stir-fry peppers and onions for 4-5 minutes until charred.
Return beef to the skillet and toss everything together.
Serve immediately with warm flour tortillas, salsa, and lime wedges.

recipes.name: Nachos con Carne
recipes.description: Crispy tortilla chips loaded with seasoned ground beef, melted cheese, jalapeños, and fresh toppings.

steps.instruction: Preheat oven to 190°C and spread chips on a large baking sheet.
Brown ground beef in a skillet, drain excess fat.
Season beef with cumin, chili powder, and salt.
Layer seasoned beef and shredded cheese over the chips.
Bake for 8-10 minutes until cheese is bubbly and melted.
Top with jalapeños, tomatoes, onion, sour cream, and cilantro.

recipes.name: Quesadilla de Carne
recipes.description: Flour tortilla filled with seasoned shredded beef and melted Oaxaca cheese, griddled to golden perfection.

steps.instruction: Warm shredded beef in a skillet with a splash of its cooking juices.
Lay out tortillas and fill one half with beef, cheese, onion, and cilantro.
Fold tortillas in half and press gently.
Heat butter in a griddle over medium heat.
Cook each quesadilla for 3 minutes per side until golden and cheese melts.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa verde and sour cream.

recipes.name: Cecina Enchilada
recipes.description: Thinly sliced beef marinated in a chili-lime adobo and lightly dried, a Guerrero specialty.

steps.instruction: Blend soaked guajillo chiles with garlic, cumin, oregano, lime juice, vinegar, and salt.
Lay beef slices flat and coat both sides with the chili marinade.
Stack slices and let marinate for at least 2 hours, ideally overnight.
Heat a griddle over high heat.
Cook beef slices for 1-2 minutes per side until slightly charred.
Serve with fresh tortillas, salsa, and lime wedges.

recipes.name: Tasajo
recipes.description: Thin-cut salted and dried beef from Oaxaca, grilled over open flame for a smoky, intensely beefy flavor.

steps.instruction: Rinse tasajo briefly under water to remove excess salt.
Pat completely dry with paper towels.
Heat a griddle or grill to high heat.
Brush lightly with oil and cook tasajo for 2-3 minutes per side.
Squeeze lime juice over the meat immediately after cooking.
Serve with grilled nopales, quesillo, and warm corn tortillas.

recipes.name: Longaniza Mexicana
recipes.description: Spiced ground pork sausage seasoned with guajillo and ancho chiles, grilled until snappy and juicy.

steps.instruction: Combine ground pork with all seasonings and vinegar in a bowl.
Mix thoroughly and let marinate for 1 hour.
Form into a long log or stuff into natural casings.
Grill over medium heat, turning occasionally, for 15-18 minutes.
Let rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Serve in corn tortillas with salsa and pickled onions.

recipes.name: Carne Adobada
recipes.description: Pork marinated in a vibrant red chile paste and grilled until charred, a Yucatán street food staple.

steps.instruction: Toast ancho and guajillo chiles in a dry pan, then soak in hot water for 20 minutes.
Blend soaked chiles with garlic, cumin, oregano, pepper, vinegar, salt, and orange juice.
Coat pork slices generously with the adobo paste.
Marinate for at least 4 hours, ideally overnight in the refrigerator.
Grill pork over medium-high heat for 4-5 minutes per side.
Serve in warm corn tortillas with pickled red onions and habanero salsa.

recipes.name: Tinga de Pollo
recipes.description: Shredded chicken simmered in a smoky chipotle-tomato sauce, a Puebla classic.

steps.instruction: Poach chicken breast in salted water for 20 minutes until cooked through.
Shred the chicken finely and set aside.
Blend tomatoes, chipotle peppers, garlic, oregano, and cumin into a smooth sauce.
Sauté sliced onion in oil until translucent.
Pour in the chipotle sauce and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add shredded chicken, stir to combine, and cook for another 5 minutes.
Serve in tostadas, tacos, or over rice.

recipes.name: Pollo en Pipián
recipes.description: Chicken bathed in a rich, earthy pumpkin seed and sesame seed sauce from Puebla.

steps.instruction: Toast pumpkin seeds and sesame seeds separately in a dry pan until golden.
Toast the pasilla chile briefly and soak in hot water for 10 minutes.
Blend pumpkin seeds, sesame seeds, soaked chile, onion, garlic, tomatillos, cumin, and oregano into a thick paste.
Season chicken thighs with salt and brown in a Dutch oven.
Pour the pipián sauce and broth over the chicken.
Simmer covered for 30 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Serve with white rice and warm corn tortillas.

recipes.name: Arroz con Pollo
recipes.description: Mexican chicken and rice cooked together in a tomato sauce with peas and carrots.

steps.instruction: Rinse rice until water runs clear, then set aside.
Season chicken with salt and brown in oil in a large pot. Remove and set aside.
Sauté onion and garlic until fragrant, then add rice and toast for 2 minutes.
Pour in blended tomatoes, broth, cumin, and salt. Stir well.
Nestle chicken thighs into the rice, cover, and cook on low heat for 25 minutes.
Scatter peas and carrots on top, cover, and steam for 5 more minutes.
Fluff with a fork and serve family-style.

videos.videoTitle: Delicious Arroz Con Pollo - Mexican Chicken And Rice Recipe!

recipes.name: Enchiladas de Pollo
recipes.description: Corn tortillas rolled with shredded chicken, bathed in green tomatillo sauce, and topped with crema.

steps.instruction: Poach chicken in salted water for 20 minutes, then shred finely.
Boil tomatillos, jalapeños, onion, and garlic until soft, then blend with cilantro and salt.
Fry tortillas briefly in oil to soften, then drain on paper towels.
Dip each tortilla in the green sauce, fill with shredded chicken, and roll up.
Arrange enchiladas in a baking dish and pour remaining sauce on top.
Drizzle with crema and sprinkle with queso fresco. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Pollo a la Plancha
recipes.description: Marinated chicken breast pan-seared until golden, served with a bright tomatillo salsa.

steps.instruction: Butterfly chicken breasts to even thickness for uniform cooking.
Marinate with lime juice, garlic, cumin, oregano, salt, pepper, and olive oil for 30 minutes.
Heat a griddle or grill pan over medium-high heat.
Cook chicken for 5-6 minutes per side until golden and internal temp reaches 74°C.
Rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Serve with tomatillo salsa, rice, and a simple salad.

recipes.name: Taco de Pollo
recipes.description: Seasoned shredded chicken in warm corn tortillas topped with onion, cilantro, and salsa verde.

steps.instruction: Poach chicken with garlic and salt for 20 minutes until cooked through.
Shred the chicken finely.
Toast guajillo chiles, soak, and blend with garlic, cumin, and salt into a sauce.
Toss shredded chicken in the chile sauce and warm through.
Heat corn tortillas on a dry griddle until pliable.
Fill tortillas with chicken, top with onion, cilantro, and salsa verde. Serve with lime.

recipes.name: Pollo Guisado
recipes.description: Chicken pieces braised in a tomato and chile sauce until tender and deeply flavored.

steps.instruction: Season chicken thighs with salt and brown on all sides in oil. Remove and set aside.
Sauté onion, garlic, and poblano until softened.
Add tomatoes, cumin, and oregano, cooking for 5 minutes.
Pour in broth and return chicken to the pot.
Add potato cubes, cover, and simmer for 30 minutes.
Adjust seasoning and serve with warm tortillas.

recipes.name: Pollo Campechano
recipes.description: A rustic mix of chicken pieces cooked in a bold tomato-chile sauce with nopales and chayote.

steps.instruction: Season chicken pieces with salt and brown in oil. Remove and set aside.
Sauté onion and garlic until translucent.
Add blended tomatoes and serrano chiles, cooking for 5 minutes.
Stir in nopales and chayote cubes.
Return chicken to the pot, add cumin, and add enough water to partially cover.
Simmer covered for 35 minutes until chicken and vegetables are tender.
Serve with corn tortillas and white rice.

recipes.name: Albóndigas de Pollo
recipes.description: Light chicken meatballs simmered in a savory tomato broth with zucchini and carrots.

steps.instruction: Mix ground chicken with uncooked rice, half the onion (minced), egg, mint, salt, and cumin. Form into 16 meatballs.
Heat oil in a large pot and sauté remaining onion until soft.
Pour in blended tomatoes and chicken broth. Bring to a boil.
Gently drop meatballs into the simmering broth.
Add carrots and cook for 15 minutes.
Add zucchini and cook for another 10 minutes until rice in meatballs is tender.
Season with oregano and serve hot.

recipes.name: Pollo Frito
recipes.description: Chicken pieces marinated in lime and spices, coated in seasoned flour and deep-fried to crispy golden perfection.

steps.instruction: Marinate chicken pieces with lime juice, salt, garlic powder, and cumin for 1 hour.
Mix flour, cornstarch, paprika, pepper, and remaining salt in a large bowl.
Heat oil to 170°C in a deep pot or fryer.
Dredge each piece thoroughly in the seasoned flour mixture.
Fry chicken in batches for 12-15 minutes, turning occasionally, until deep golden.
Drain on a wire rack and serve with lime wedges and salsa.

recipes.name: Pollo con Mole
recipes.description: Chicken simmered in mole poblano, a complex sauce of chiles, chocolate, and warm spices.

steps.instruction: Toast dried chiles in a dry pan, then soak in hot water for 20 minutes.
Toast sesame seeds, almonds, and raisins separately in a dry pan.
Blend soaked chiles with onion, garlic, cumin, cinnamon, almonds, raisins, and sesame seeds.
Fry the paste in oil for 5 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add chicken broth and chocolate, stirring until chocolate melts.
Brown chicken pieces and add to the mole, simmering for 30 minutes.
Serve with white rice and warm tortillas, garnished with sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Entomatado de Pollo
recipes.description: Chicken pieces gently simmered in a bright, fresh tomato sauce with mild chiles.

steps.instruction: Blanch tomatoes in boiling water, peel, and blend with onion, garlic, and serrano chile.
Season chicken with salt and brown in oil. Remove and set aside.
Pour the tomato sauce into the pot and cook for 8 minutes.
Add broth, oregano, and cumin. Return chicken to the sauce.
Cover and simmer for 25-30 minutes until chicken is tender.
Adjust seasoning and serve with rice and warm corn tortillas.

recipes.name: Chilorio de Pollo
recipes.description: Shredded chicken slow-cooked in a rich chile and vinegar sauce until dry and intensely flavored.

steps.instruction: Boil chicken breast until cooked through, then shred finely.
Toast and soak dried chiles for 15 minutes.
Blend soaked chiles with vinegar, garlic, cumin, oregano, and salt.
Heat lard in a skillet and fry the chile paste for 5 minutes.
Add shredded chicken and stir to coat evenly.
Cook on low heat for 20 minutes, stirring often, until the mixture is dry.
Serve in tortillas with avocado and pickled onions.

recipes.name: Quesadilla de Tinga
recipes.description: Crispy flour tortilla filled with smoky chipotle tinga and melted cheese.

steps.instruction: Prepare tinga de pollo if not already made (chipotle-shredded chicken).
Lay out flour tortillas and spread tinga on one half.
Top with shredded cheese and a few onion slices.
Fold tortillas in half and press gently.
Cook in butter on a griddle over medium heat for 3 minutes per side.
Drizzle with crema and serve with salsa verde.

recipes.name: Pollo Encaramelado
recipes.description: Chicken thighs slow-cooked in a caramelized onion and chipotle sauce until sticky and rich.

steps.instruction: Season chicken thighs with salt and brown skin-side down in oil. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, cook sliced onions on medium-low heat for 20 minutes until deeply caramelized.
Add garlic and chipotle, cooking for 2 minutes.
Stir in brown sugar and balsamic vinegar.
Return chicken skin-side up, pour in broth, and add thyme.
Cover and simmer for 30 minutes until sauce is thick and chicken is tender.
Serve over rice with warm tortillas.

recipes.name: Nopalitos Guisados
recipes.description: Tender cactus paddles diced and simmered with tomatoes, onions, and mild chiles.

steps.instruction: Scrape and dice nopales, removing the outer skin and spines.
Boil nopales in salted water for 15 minutes until tender, then drain.
Heat oil and sauté onion, garlic, and jalapeño until softened.
Add tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in nopales and oregano.
Cook uncovered for 10 minutes until flavors meld. Serve as a side or in tacos.

videos.videoTitle: Receta Nopalitos Placeros con SECRETO  para quitar la baba del nopal|| EL SECRETO PARA COCER NOPALES

recipes.name: Frijoles Refritos
recipes.description: Creamy mashed pinto beans cooked down with lard and aromatics until silky and rich.

steps.instruction: Heat lard or oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Sauté onion until golden, then add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add cooked beans with a splash of their broth.
Mash beans with the back of a wooden spoon or potato masher.
Stir and cook, adding small amounts of broth as needed, for 10-15 minutes.
Season with salt and cumin. Serve as a side dish or taco filling.

videos.videoTitle: Frijoles Refritos | Better Beans Than That One Restaurant You're Thinking Of

recipes.name: Elote
recipes.description: Grilled corn on the cob slathered in mayo, cotija cheese, chili powder, and lime.

steps.instruction: Grill corn over high heat, turning occasionally, for 10-12 minutes until charred.
Mix mayo with a squeeze of lime juice.
Brush each ear generously with the mayo mixture.
Roll in crumbled cotija cheese.
Dust with chili powder and a pinch of salt.
Squeeze fresh lime juice over the top and sprinkle with cilantro.

videos.videoTitle: Elote Recipe - How to Make Authentic Mexican Street Corn at Home!

recipes.name: Chilaquiles Verdes
recipes.description: Crispy tortilla chips simmered in tangy green tomatillo sauce, topped with crema, cheese, and egg.

steps.instruction: Fry tortilla wedges in hot oil until crispy and golden. Drain on paper towels.
Boil tomatillos, jalapeños, onion, and garlic until soft, then blend with salt.
Pour the green sauce into a skillet and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the crispy tortilla chips and toss to coat.
Cook for 2-3 minutes so chips soften slightly but keep some crunch.
Serve topped with crema, queso fresco, diced onion, cilantro, and a fried egg.

recipes.name: Rajas con Crema
recipes.description: Roasted poblano pepper strips simmered in a luscious cream sauce with sweet corn kernels.

steps.instruction: Roast poblano peppers over a flame or under a broiler until charred all over.
Place in a bag to steam, then peel, seed, and slice into strips.
Melt butter in a skillet and sauté onion until translucent.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in poblano strips and corn kernels.
Pour in crema, season with salt, and simmer for 10 minutes.
Garnish with queso fresco and serve as a side or filling.

recipes.name: Frijoles Charros
recipes.description: Hearty pinto bean soup loaded with onions, tomatoes, chiles, and herbs, named after Mexican cowboys.

steps.instruction: Heat oil in a large pot and sauté onion until translucent.
Add garlic and jalapeños, cooking for 2 minutes.
Stir in tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes.
Add cooked pinto beans with their broth.
Season with oregano and salt, then bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in fresh cilantro and serve hot.

recipes.name: Sopa de Tortilla
recipes.description: Crispy tortilla strips in a rich, smoky tomato-chile broth topped with avocado and crema.

steps.instruction: Fry tortilla strips in hot oil until crispy. Drain and season with salt.
Toast pasilla chile briefly, then soak in hot water for 10 minutes.
Blend tomatoes, soaked chile, onion, and garlic into a smooth sauce.
Heat a little oil and fry the tomato sauce for 5 minutes.
Add broth and simmer for 15 minutes. Season with salt.
Serve broth in bowls topped with crispy tortilla strips, avocado, crema, and cheese.

recipes.name: Chiles Rellenos
recipes.description: Roasted poblano peppers stuffed with melted cheese, coated in fluffy egg batter, and fried golden.

steps.instruction: Roast poblanos over flame until charred, steam in a bag, then peel and carefully slit open.
Stuff each pepper with cheese strips and secure with toothpicks.
Blend tomatoes, onion, and garlic into a smooth sauce. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Beat egg whites to stiff peaks, then gently fold in yolks with a pinch of salt.
Heat oil to 180°C. Dust peppers in flour, then coat in egg batter.
Fry until golden, about 2-3 minutes per side. Drain on paper towels.
Serve with warm tomato sauce and rice.

recipes.name: Tamales de Elote
recipes.description: Sweet corn tamales made with fresh corn masa, butter, and sugar for a delicate, tender treat.

steps.instruction: Soak dried corn husks in warm water for at least 30 minutes.
Blend fresh corn kernels into a smooth purée.
Mix masa harina with butter until fluffy, then fold in corn purée, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
Spread masa onto soaked corn husks, about 2 tablespoons each.
Add a small strip of cream cheese in the center if desired.
Fold husks to enclose the filling and steam for 45-50 minutes.
Let rest for 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.name: Guacamole Fresco
recipes.description: Classic chunky guacamole with ripe avocados, fresh lime, serrano chile, and cilantro.

steps.instruction: Halve avocados, remove pits, and scoop flesh into a bowl.
Mash with a fork to a chunky texture, leaving some pieces intact.
Fold in lime juice, diced onion, and minced serrano.
Add cilantro and diced tomato, stirring gently.
Season with salt and taste for balance.
Serve immediately with tortilla chips or alongside any Mexican meal.

videos.videoTitle: How to Make Fresh Homemade Guacamole - Easy Guacamole Recipe

recipes.name: Pico de Gallo
recipes.description: A fresh raw salsa of diced tomato, onion, jalapeño, cilantro, and lime juice.

steps.instruction: Dice tomatoes into small, uniform cubes and place in a bowl.
Add finely diced onion and minced jalapeño.
Toss in chopped cilantro.
Squeeze lime juice over the mixture.
Season with salt and toss gently to combine.
Let sit for 10 minutes to meld flavors before serving with chips or tacos.

recipes.name: Frijoles de la Olla
recipes.description: Whole pinto beans simmered in a clay pot with onion, garlic, and herbs until creamy and tender.

steps.instruction: Drain and rinse soaked pinto beans.
Place beans in a large pot with water, onion halves, garlic, and bay leaf.
Bring to a boil, then reduce to a gentle simmer.
Cook uncovered for 1.5-2 hours until beans are creamy and tender.
Season with salt and oregano in the last 30 minutes of cooking.
Remove onion and bay leaf. Serve as a side or mash for refried beans.

recipes.name: Arroz Verde
recipes.description: Fluffy Mexican green rice tinted with poblano, spinach, and cilantro, cooked with garlic and broth.

steps.instruction: Roast poblano pepper until charred, then peel and seed.
Blend poblano, spinach, cilantro, onion, and garlic with half the broth until smooth.
Rinse rice until water runs clear.
Heat oil in a saucepan and toast rice for 3 minutes.
Pour in the green puree and remaining broth. Season with salt.
Bring to a boil, cover, reduce heat, and cook for 18 minutes.
Fluff with a fork and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.name: Nopales Asados
recipes.description: Grilled cactus paddles marinated in lime, garlic, and chile, charred and served as a smoky side.

steps.instruction: Clean nopales by scraping off spines and outer skin, then cut into strips or paddles.
Boil nopales for 10 minutes to remove slime, then drain well.
Toss with lime juice, garlic, oregano, chile powder, olive oil, and salt.
Let marinate for 15 minutes.
Grill over high heat for 3-4 minutes per side until charred.
Serve as a side dish, taco filling, or salad topping.

recipes.name: Ensalada de Nopal
recipes.description: Fresh cactus salad with tomatoes, onions, cilantro, and crumbled cheese in a bright lime dressing.

steps.instruction: Boil diced nopales in salted water for 15 minutes until tender.
Drain well and let cool to room temperature.
Combine nopales with diced tomatoes, onion, jalapeño, and cilantro.
Dress with lime juice, olive oil, and salt.
Toss everything gently to combine.
Top with crumbled queso fresco and serve as a fresh side salad.

recipes.name: Tres Leches
recipes.description: Fluffy sponge cake soaked in three kinds of milk and topped with pillowy whipped cream.

steps.instruction: Beat egg yolks with sugar until pale and thick.
Fold in flour gently, then beat egg whites to stiff peaks and fold into the batter.
Pour into a buttered baking dish and bake at 175°C for 25-30 minutes.
Mix evaporated milk, condensed milk, 240ml cream, and vanilla.
Poke holes in the warm cake and slowly pour the milk mixture over it.
Refrigerate for at least 4 hours, ideally overnight.
Top with whipped cream dusted with cinnamon before serving.

videos.videoTitle: Rick Bayless Classic Tres Leches Cake

recipes.name: Arroz con Leche
recipes.description: Creamy Mexican rice pudding infused with cinnamon, vanilla, and condensed milk.

steps.instruction: Rinse rice and boil in water with cinnamon sticks for 15 minutes until tender.
Drain any excess water.
Add whole milk and condensed milk to the rice.
Cook over low heat for 20 minutes, stirring frequently.
Stir in raisins and vanilla extract.
Continue cooking until thick and creamy, about 10 more minutes.
Serve warm or chilled, dusted with ground cinnamon.

recipes.name: Chongos Zamoranos
recipes.description: Curds of milk slowly simmered in cinnamon-spiced whey until caramelized, a Michoacán delicacy.

steps.instruction: Heat milk in a wide pot until it just begins to simmer.
Beat eggs lightly and stir into the warm milk.
Add sugar, cinnamon sticks, vanilla, and salt.
Cook on very low heat for 1.5-2 hours without stirring.
The mixture will curdle and the whey will turn golden and syrupy.
Carefully transfer curds and syrup to a serving dish.
Chill completely before serving.

recipes.name: Cajeta
recipes.description: Slow-cooked goat milk caramel with a deep, complex sweetness, drizzled over ice cream or spread on bread.

steps.instruction: Combine goat milk, sugar, and cinnamon stick in a heavy-bottomed pot.
Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring to dissolve sugar.
Add the dissolved baking soda (the mixture will foam).
Reduce heat and simmer for 45-60 minutes, stirring frequently.
When it thickens and turns amber, remove cinnamon stick.
Stir in butter, vanilla, and salt.
Pour into a jar and let cool. It thickens further as it cools.

recipes.name: Dulce de Leche
recipes.description: Rich milk caramel made by slowly cooking condensed milk until thick, smooth, and deeply golden.

steps.instruction: Pour condensed milk into a heavy saucepan.
Add vanilla, baking soda, and a pinch of salt.
Cook over very low heat, stirring constantly, for 30-40 minutes.
The mixture will gradually darken and thicken.
When it reaches a deep caramel color and coats a spoon, remove from heat.
Transfer to a jar and let cool completely.
Serve drizzled over churros, ice cream, or spread on toast.

recipes.name: Buñuelos
recipes.description: Crispy fried dough discs dusted with cinnamon sugar, a beloved Christmas and New Year treat.

steps.instruction: Mix flour, baking powder, sugar, and salt in a large bowl.
Make a well and add eggs, melted butter, milk, and vanilla. Mix into a soft dough.
Knead for 5 minutes until smooth, then cover and rest for 30 minutes.
Divide dough into 12 balls and roll each very thin into a circle.
Heat oil to 180°C and fry each disc for 30-60 seconds until golden and puffy.
Drain and immediately dust with cinnamon-sugar mixture.
Serve warm. They crisp up as they cool.

recipes.name: Pan de Muerto
recipes.description: Soft, orange-blossom scented bread decorated with bone-shaped dough, traditionally for Day of the Dead.

steps.instruction: Dissolve yeast in warm milk with a pinch of sugar and let bloom for 10 minutes.
Mix flour, sugar, and salt. Add eggs one at a time, then the yeast mixture.
Knead in softened butter, orange zest, and orange blossom water for 10 minutes.
Cover and let rise for 2 hours until doubled.
Shape the main loaf and form small dough balls for the bone decorations.
Arrange bone shapes on top and let rise for 1 hour.
Bake at 180°C for 25-30 minutes until golden.
Brush with melted butter and sprinkle with sugar while warm.

recipes.name: Cocada
recipes.description: Chewy coconut candy made with condensed milk and vanilla, shaped into rustic rounds.

steps.instruction: Combine shredded coconut and condensed milk in a heavy saucepan.
Cook over medium-low heat, stirring constantly, for 15-20 minutes.
The mixture will thicken and pull away from the sides of the pan.
Stir in vanilla and cinnamon.
Drop rounded tablespoons onto a buttered tray or parchment paper.
Let cool completely at room temperature until set.
Serve at room temperature. Store in an airtight container.

recipes.name: Bistec en Salsa
recipes.description: Beef steak in roasted tomato salsa

steps.instruction: Grill beef steak.
Roast tomatoes and jalapeno.
Blend into salsa.
Serve beef topped with salsa.

recipes.name: Chiles Rellenos Queso
recipes.description: Roasted poblano peppers stuffed with cheese

steps.instruction: Roast and peel poblanos.
Stuff with cheese.
Dip in egg batter and fry.
Serve with tomato sauce.

recipes.name: Esquites Callejeros
recipes.description: Mexican street corn salad in a cup

steps.instruction: Saute corn until charred.
Mix with mayonnaise and lime.
Top with chili powder and cheese.
Garnish with cilantro.
